paragraphs: GitDojo is an open-source interactive Git learning environment where developers learn Git by typing real commands, manipulating safe browser-based repositories, and visualizing what happens internally.

Status: early development. Five courses, from Git Basics to Undo and Recover, ten real-world challenges and a free playground run end to end in the browser: a real Git engine, a terminal and code editor, live working tree / staging / branch graph visualization, state-based objective validation, progressive hints, plain-words error explanations, a progress dashboard saved locally with no account, and optional accounts through WSO2 Identity Platform. Syncing progress to accounts is on the roadmap.
